conclusion: The historical manual putin path persisted wom_putin_details but skipped WOMActiExelog creation for RM_activeType/putin, so wom_mat_consum_recods was not generated. The current WOM service patch creates the missing activity execution record and reuses WOMActiExelogServiceImpl.generateInOutRecordByAvtiveRecord. A clean real browser/API/PostgreSQL run now proves one putin detail, one finished activity execution and one material-consumption row with no visible warning or error notice.

sourceEvidence.summary: RM_activeType/putin is included in noCreateActiExe, so startActive does not create WOMActiExelog for manual putin.
endActive only calls generateInOutRecordByAvtiveRecord while iterating existing actiExelogs.
toProcfeedback validates WOMPutinDetail rows and handles remain material; the put-in material bill generation block is commented out.
generateInOutRecordByAvtiveRecord creates WOMMatConsumRecod for putin activities from WOMActiExelog fields.
The delete hook that would link WOMPutinDetail to WOMMatConsumRecod is commented out.

historicalRemoteVerification.sql: SELECT 'activeExelogCount', count(*) FROM public.wom_acti_exelogs WHERE task_active_id = 8388157617258688 UNION ALL SELECT 'matConsumCount', count(*) FROM public.wom_mat_consum_recods WHERE put_mat_detail_id = 755716019803392 OR putin_material_detail_id = 755716019803392;
